data.name: A Firm Handshake
data.detailed_description:
A short, surreal series of vignettes about touching. Guide our hero through an arduous day of business.

Features:

  • Four-directional input

  • Fully physically simulated handshakes

  • Business attire

Playtime: 10-15 minutes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 or Vulkan compatible, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (dual-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz (x86_64)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
